Class NetBeansAsiContainer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.event.BasicPropertyChangeSource

uno.anahata.asi.nb.NetBeansAsiContainer
All Implemented Interfaces:
uno.anahata.asi.agi.event.PropertyChangeSource, uno.anahata.asi.persistence.Rebindable
public class NetBeansAsiContainer extends uno.anahata.asi.swing.AbstractSwingAsiContainer
NetBeans-specific configuration for the Anahata ASI.

Handles IDE-specific initialization and session management. Global environment configuration (parameter renderers, JSON modules) is performed once during static initialization.

anahata
